caption: The drawing depicts two views of a brown leather shoe set against a plain, light beige background. On the left side, the bottom view of the shoe's sole is shown, illustrating its oval shape, tan color, and dark brown, nearly black arch section. Small, regularly spaced dots surround the edge of the sole, likely representing stitches or tacks, and a small, dark symbol resembling the number "7" is located near the toe. On the right side, a side view of the same shoe is provided, showing the shoe's brown leather upper with darker and lighter shading that indicates depth and wear, four eyelets for laces, a short heel, and light tan edges at the sole and toe. The composition is simple and clear, with both views of the shoe positioned for direct comparison on a clean background.
title: Child's Shoes
